notes.title: Update Notes - August 20 2023
notes.content:
Fixed Time Mode / Hard Mode not being unlocked after game has been cleared.

(Note: Must beat game on Normal Mode to unlock Hard Mode. Beating game on any difficulty unlocks Time Mode)

If you have beaten the game previously, please load that save on which it was completed. Your save should say "Normal, END" for example. Afterwards, return to the main menu and the mode(s) should be unlocked.
